resources.string:
This app syncs only with a sync server you run yourself, such as the one built into desktop Anki. Enter its address, then sign in. Learn more

Coming from AnkiWeb? This app cannot sign in to AnkiWeb. To bring your decks here, sync them into AnkiDroid or desktop Anki, export a collection or deck package there, and import it here.
